function.name: get_psa_trend
function.description: Retrieve the patient's prior PSA measurements as a time series (date + value). Reveals PSA velocity / trajectory beyond the single headline value already in the prompt.

function.name: get_lab_results
function.description: Retrieve the full laboratory panel for the patient (PSA, free PSA, haematology, renal function, testosterone, alkaline phosphatase, LDH, etc.) as a list of {name, val, date, flag}.

function.name: get_mri_report
function.description: Retrieve the radiologist's full mpMRI report as free text. The headline imaging values (PI-RADS, prostate volume, PSA density, AI csPCa probability) are already in the prompt; this is the prose report behind them.

function.name: get_previous_notes
function.description: Retrieve previous GP / urology consultation notes for this patient, as a list of {date, author, text}.

function.name: get_family_history
function.description: Ask the patient about their first-degree family history of prostate cancer (father / brothers). Returns 'Yes', 'No', or 'Unknown'. This is anamnesis elicited during the consultation rather than information present in the EHR up front, so it must be actively requested.

function.name: search_guidelines
function.description:
Search clinical guidelines and protocols relevant to the query.

        Uses semantic similarity search over a knowledge base of clinical
        guidelines (e.g. EAU prostate-cancer guidelines, NCCN protocols).
        Returns the most relevant guideline passages. Free-text query;
        phrase as a clinical question.
